name: Runtime Audit / Log Hygiene V1
problem: Validation and API smoke runs can append runtime audit rows to tracked files such as services/shf-agent-fabric/var/watchtower_audit.jsonl, leaving the working tree dirty and creating release/staging risk.
implemented_changes: Created scripts/check_runtime_log_hygiene.py to report tracked/dirty runtime log state.
Created scripts/clean_runtime_audit_logs.sh as a narrow cleanup helper for the known tracked Watchtower runtime audit file.
Added non-strict runtime hygiene check to npm run check:governance.
Created Runtime Audit / Log Hygiene V1 documentation and JSON evidence.
owner_approval_required_for: Replacing tracked runtime logs with sample/template files.
Adding narrow .gitignore rules for currently tracked runtime audit artifacts.
Moving runtime audit output paths or changing Watchtower audit write behavior.
